HotelDetail.packageNote: We can include these hotels as part of your Sri Lanka holiday plan and arrange transfers, excursions, and airport pickup around your booking.

partners.title: Our Accommodation Partners
partners.subtitle: Experience true Sri Lankan hospitality
partners.copy: Browse hand-picked Sri Lankan stays that work well for beach holidays, round trips, and private tours. Each property page includes a quick overview and the details needed to plan your stay.

ratings.title: Hotel Star Classifications
ratings.subtitle: A quick guide to the standard of service and facilities

items.label: 5 Stars
items.value: Superior standard and an extensive range of first-class guest services

items.label: 4 Stars
items.value: Exceptional standard with high-quality furnishings and comfort

items.label: 3 Stars
items.value: Well-appointed establishments with comfortable, clean rooms and quality furnishings

items.label: Unclassified Hotels
items.value: Well maintained properties with adequate facilities which do not fall under star classifications.

items.label: Boutique Hotel and Villas
items.value: Small but exclusive property that caters to the affluent clientele with an exceptional level of service at premium prices.

types.title: Common Hotel Types
types.subtitle: Accommodation styles you may see in Sri Lanka

items.label: Bungalow
items.value: A type of real estate property that consists of a small, one story home with an enclosed porch.

items.label: Home Stay
items.value: A stay at a residence by a traveler and especially by a tourist who is hosted by a local family to better learn about the local lifestyle

items.label: Rented Apartments
items.value: Is a room or suite of rooms designed as a residence and generally located in a building occupied by more than one household.

items.label: Guest House
items.value: Guest houses range from low budget rooms to luxury apartments, and tend to be like small hotels in larger cities.

items.label: Boutique Hotel
items.value: Small but exclusive property that caters to the affluent clientele with an exceptional level of service at premium prices.

help.copy: If you want help selecting the right hotel type for your trip, we can match the stay to your route, budget, and preferred level of service.

devi.title: Devi Tranquil Villa
devi.subtitle: Sri Lankan Hotel
devi.overview: Devi Tranquil Villa is a calm, small-scale stay that suits travelers who want a quieter base with practical service, good access, and a more personal atmosphere than a large resort hotel.

gallery.title: Comfortable rooms
gallery.text: Well-suited for short stays, round trips, and couples looking for a quieter accommodation base.

gallery.title: Easy holiday planning
gallery.text: A practical choice when you want to combine accommodation with excursions and transfers.

secrets.title: Secrets of Ceylon
secrets.subtitle: Boutique Hotel
secrets.overview: Secrets of Ceylon is presented as a boutique-style property with a more elevated service feel, making it a strong fit for travelers who want comfort, privacy, and a polished guest experience.

gallery.title: Refined stay
gallery.text: A polished setting that works well for guests who want a more curated accommodation choice.

gallery.title: Tour-friendly base
gallery.text: A useful stop for touring itineraries where quality of stay matters as much as location.
